query:
Both Claudette and Vera expressed concern about parking in relation to the no. 22 planning application. Who was specifically concerned about parking being blocked during construction works, and who was opposed to the development on character grounds?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Vera, episodic, t0 @2025-05-05T18:52:00) Already sent mine to the council. Main concerns: scaffolding access, parking disruption during works.
[2] (about=Claudette, episodic, t0 @2025-05-05T11:17:00) I saw it this morning. I remember when no. 22 was a single-storey cottage. This street does not need any more bulk added to it. I shall be objecting.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Claudette, group-interaction, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) Include driveway at no. 19 in the note.
[4] (about=Femi, episodic, t1 @2025-05-12T15:15:00) Quick question for the street, the council is consulting on a Residents' Parking Zone for our road. Proposal is controlled hours Mon–Fri 8am–6pm, permits at £80/year. Thoughts? I want to know where everyone stands before the meeting.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T15:35:00) I'm in favour. As a parent, the school gate situation is untenable, people park on the pavement all morning. Permits would fix that overnight.
[6] (about=Vera, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T18:03:00) Support the scheme. Home visits mean I need parking here on clinic days.
agent_answer:
- Parking being blocked during construction works: **D. Vera** (Vera: "parking disruption during works").
- Opposed on character grounds: **A. Claudette** (Claudette: no. 22 should remain a single-storey cottage; "This street does not need any more bulk added to it").
